notes.title: UPDATE #2
notes.content:
[b]Thank you for all your feedback and support![/b]

We're committed to making our game the best experience possible, and with your help, we've addressed several key issues. Here's what's been improved in the latest update:

[list]
[*] Improved game optimization for smoother performance.
[*] Increased the speed of the auto-skip button for a more seamless experience.
[*] Fixed bugs related to achievement unlocking for one of the endings.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued input and look forward to hearing more from you!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
We’ve introduced a new Auto-Skip feature, designed especially for players who love exploring every possible ending. This feature becomes available in the OPTIONS menu after you’ve completed the game for the first time.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45210834/2c7b35f7f61fd69b3d7db428f2240f1ef30b6390.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45210834/a68215d2e75875ffecab8956f710ff7d4a43d81d.png[/img]

However, we encourage you to approach the story with a fresh perspective each time. Sometimes, taking a break and coming back to the game later can offer a rich experience as you explore new paths.

Thank you everyone who plays the game and reviews it!
